loader.observed_contract: Expects color/depth/label PNG files and meta.mat with cls_indexes, poses, factor_depth; object model points.xyz. This is code expectation, not verification of downloaded RGBD/GT/camera registration or pallet-native visibility.

important_limits: No RGB/depth/label/model payload from this candidate was acquired or verified.
No native slot correspondence, per-keypoint D/E/SELF, initial query predictions or current evaluation performance is available from this metadata.

Dataset license and redistribution/use terms were not established in this bounded inspection; no raw data redistribution or training admission.
Prior historical use in every earlier experiment was not exhaustively audited. Do not claim this candidate is an entirely untried idea.
